US Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz got into a shouting match with Cuba’s foreign minister on the floor of the general assembly hall Tuesday as he was detailing the Communist regime’s real estate holdings.

As Waltz spoke, Cuban foreign minister Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla charged toward the rostrum and accused Waltz of lying, causing the US envoy to shout: “Back up!”

“He’s not going to intimidate me in the United States of America — like he tries to intimidate political prisoners,” said Waltz, raising his voice at Parrilla as UN officials tried to restore order.

A video obtained by The Post showed Waltz spokesman J.P. Freire apparently being assaulted by another member of the Cuban delegation who tried to grab Freire’s iPhone as he was recording the confrontation.

Members of the Cuban delegation were recording their own videos as Parrilla approached Waltz mid-speech.

Freire ظاهراً توسط یکی دیگر از اعضای هیئت ضبط آیفون کوبایی مورد حمله قرار گرفته است. اعضای هیئت کوبایی در حال ضبط ویدیوهای خود بودند که پارلا به وسط سخنرانی والتز نزدیک می شد.

Turnout for Israel’s 2026 elections is at its highest pace in more than 50 years, officials said — with Wonder Woman actor Gal Gadot among those who cast their ballot on Tuesday calling for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s ouster.

Nearly 45% of voters have cast their ballots as of 2 p.m. local time, the highest turnout recorded at that hour since 1973, according to the Central Elections Committee.

That equates to nearly 3.3 million out of Israel’s 7.3 million voters, with citizens continuing to flock to the polls in a heated race between Netanyahu’s right-wing alliance and the opposition coalition led by ex military chief Gadi Eisenkot.

Gadot posted an Instagram story of herself voting Tuesday morning as she called on her fellow Israelis to make their voice count.

“That’s it, I’m exercising my right to vote, and I ask all of you to go out and exercise your most basic, most important, the most democratic right, and to vote for who you believe in,” Gadot said at her polling site.

“I’m voting for change, and I hope that today, Tuesday… that it will only be good for us all,” she added, blowing a kiss at the camera.

Israel is the only nation in a region still dominated by hereditary monarchs that has regular free and fair democratic elections. This is the Jewish state’s sixth election in seven years.

Gadot cast her ballot after receiving an honorary doctorate from Israel’s Bar-Ilan University on Monday night, where she also called on the crowd to head to the polls.

Though Gadot did not name who she voted for, opposition leader Eisenkot is the main figure in Israel’s so-called “change bloc,” which is running to oust Netanyahu, who has served as Israel’s longest running prime minister.

Prior to the election, nearly all of Israel’s major polls put Eisenkot’s Together coalition ahead of Netanyahu’s Likud and allied parties, but it remains to be seen if either side can secure the 61 seats necessary to claim the majority in the Knesset.

Along with a record pace turnout, the Israel Defense Forces said military turnout was also at a higher pace than the 2022 election, with at least 48% of registered voters coming out as of 1 p.m. local time.
news.content: بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. مقامات گفتند که مشارکت در انتخابات 2026 اسرائیل به بالاترین سرعت خود در بیش از 50 سال گذشته رسیده است - با حضور گال گدوت، بازیگر زن شگفت انگیز، در میان کسانی که روز سه شنبه رای خود را به صندوق انداختند و خواستار برکناری نخست وزیر بنیامین نتانیاهو شدند. تقریباً 45 درصد از رای دهندگان رای خود را به صندوق انداخته اند. طبق اعلام کمیته مرکزی انتخابات، به وقت محلی، بالاترین میزان مشارکت ثبت شده در آن ساعت از سال 1973 است. این معادل نزدیک به 3.3 میلیون از 7.3 میلیون رای‌دهنده اسرائیل است و شهروندان همچنان به پای صندوق‌های رای هجوم می‌آورند در رقابتی داغ بین ائتلاف راست نتانیاهو و ائتلاف مخالف به رهبری گادی آیزنکوت، فرمانده سابق ارتش. گدوت در سایت نظرسنجی خود گفت: «همین است، من از حق رای خود استفاده می کنم و از همه شما می خواهم که بیرون بروید و از ابتدایی ترین، مهم ترین، دموکراتیک ترین حق خود استفاده کنید و به کسانی که به آن اعتقاد دارید رأی دهید.» اسرائیل تنها کشور در منطقه ای است که هنوز تحت سلطه پادشاهان موروثی است که انتخابات منظم و آزاد و عادلانه دموکراتیک دارد. این ششمین انتخابات دولت یهودی در هفت سال گذشته است. گادوت پس از دریافت دکترای افتخاری از دانشگاه بار-ایلان اسرائیل در دوشنبه شب، رای خود را به صندوق انداخت.

Hailey Glassman is at a “fork in the road” when it comes to her love life. In this exclusive clip from Tuesday’s all-new episode of The Real Housewives of New York City, the Season 16 newcomer gets real with Carole Radziwill about her unconventional marriage, her interest in dating women and whether it’s time to turn the page on her relationship.

Glassman has described her arrangement with her husband, Rubin Cronig, as a “lavender marriage,” explaining that she is also intimately involved with women. The two have known each other since childhood, after meeting at a sailing camp on Martha’s Vineyard, where they continue to spend time in addition to their lives in New York City. Although Rubin won’t appear on Season 16, their unconventional relationship is already a hot topic on the show.

As the girls sit in bed chatting, Radziwill asks Glassman about her husband, who lives his own life on Martha’s Vineyard. When Radziwill asks if he minds that Glassman dates women, she confirms that he doesn’t.

But when the conversation turns to whether she wants to sleep with men, Glassman makes her feelings clear.

“I just don’t wanna deal with it,” she says, adding that she would rather clean up eyelash extensions and hair on her floor than deal with men’s “little hair shavings.”

Radziwill can relate to some extent. “I mean, I barely want to sleep with men at this point,” she admits.

Glassman agrees that, these days, men sometimes “don’t bring anything to the table,” unless someone wants to have children. When Radziwill asks whether she wants kids, Glassman explains that she already has a child: Rubin.

That prompts Radziwill to ask a bigger question: “Why don’t you just be that person and not be married to him?”

Until now, Glassman said that there has never been a reason to get divorced because their arrangement works for them. But she admits that she is now facing a fork in the road, and that things could change if she met a woman she felt was worth leaving the marriage for.

Still, Glassman isn’t sugarcoating what it’s like to date women, either.

“When you date enough women, you know why men die first,” she quips, describing relationships with women as stressful and the “vibe” and “energy” as different.

Radziwill agrees that the experience is different, particularly the sex. This prompts Glassman to make an unexpected comparison between Pilates and hooking up with women. Pointing to her muscular arms, she jokes that being with women requires enough upper-body strength to hold certain positions.

“I mean, I’ve got some upper body strength and I’ve never been with a woman or taken a Pilates class,” Radziwill says in a confessional.

The conversation takes one final turn when Radziwill asks whether Glassman ever videotapes herself. Glassman quickly shuts that idea down, insisting that Ruben would never allow it.

How will Glassman’s unconventional marriage evolve as she navigates this new chapter? Tune in to The Real Housewives of New York City on Tuesday at 8 p.m. ET on Bravo to find out. New episodes stream the following day on Peacock.

بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. هیلی گلسمن وقتی صحبت از زندگی عاشقانه‌اش به میان می‌آید، در یک «انشعاب در جاده» است. در این کلیپ اختصاصی از اپیزود کاملاً جدید سه‌شنبه سریال The Real Housewives of New York City، تازه وارد فصل 16 با کارول رادزیویل در مورد ازدواج نامتعارف خود، علاقه‌اش به قرار گذاشتن با زنان و اینکه آیا زمان آن رسیده که صفحه رابطه‌اش را ورق بزند، واقعی می‌شود. گلسمن قرار خود را با همسرش، روبین کرونیگ، به عنوان یک "ازدواج اسطوخودوس" توصیف کرده است و توضیح می دهد که او نیز از نزدیک با زنان در ارتباط است. این دو پس از ملاقات در یک کمپ قایقرانی در مارتا وینارد، از دوران کودکی یکدیگر را می شناسند، جایی که آنها علاوه بر زندگی خود در شهر نیویورک، به گذراندن زمان خود ادامه می دهند. اگرچه روبین در فصل 16 ظاهر نخواهد شد، اما رابطه نامتعارف آنها در حال حاضر موضوع داغ سریال است. در حالی که دختران در رختخواب نشسته اند و صحبت می کنند، رادزیویل از گلاسمن درباره شوهرش می پرسد که زندگی خود را در تاکستان مارتا می گذراند. وقتی رادزیویل از او می‌پرسد که آیا گلاسمن با زن‌ها قرار ملاقات نمی‌دهد یا خیر، او تأیید می‌کند که با آن‌ها قرار نمی‌گذارد. اما وقتی صحبت به این می‌شود که آیا او می‌خواهد با مردان بخوابد، گلاسمن احساسات او را روشن می‌کند. او می‌گوید: «فقط نمی‌خواهم با آن کنار بیایم،» و اضافه کرد که ترجیح می‌دهد اکستنشن مژه و موهای روی زمین خود را تمیز کند تا اینکه با «تراش‌های کوچک مو» مردانه کار کند.
Radziwill می تواند تا حدودی مرتبط باشد. او اعتراف می کند: «یعنی من در این مرحله به سختی می خواهم با مردان بخوابم. گلسمن موافق است که، این روزها، مردان گاهی اوقات «نمی کنند.

Bed rotting season is nearly here, and you know what that means.

Considering the weather is getting cooler, the days are getting shorter, and the lounging hours (should!) be getting longer, it might also be time to refresh your bed sheets. There’s truly nothing better than jumping into bed with a new pair of sheets. It’s finding the right set for you that can be the challenge.

“The right set of sheets sets the stage for your entire sleeping experience,” said Dennis Chan, director of retail products for Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts.

“When choosing your bedding, investing in durability, design, and feel makes all the difference,” Chan told The Post. “Superior bedding will feel great against your skin and will withstand the test of time by maintaining quality night after night. Sheets should also complement your personal style. The bed is the centerpiece of your room, after all!”

Over the last two years, the Post Wanted team has collectively tested dozens of bed sheets. These are the 14 we think are worth your money in 2026.  Whether you’re looking for something in sateen like the Luxe Sateen Sheet from Brooklinen or prefer something soft, sustainable and cooling, like the Buffy Eucalyptus Sheets, we’ve found the sets and brands that have you and your mattress covered. If you’re interested in more cooling sheets, check out our review of our best cooling sheets.

To learn what to look for when testing and reviewing bed sheets, we spoke with Karin Sun, textile expert and founder of Crane & Canopy on the different types of sheets to choose from. Jump to our FAQ with her or keep scrolling to our top sheet picks.

For more bedding recommendations to shop, check out our guides on the best duvets, pillows, throw blankets and weighted blankets.

These bestselling sheets from Luxome are nothing to sleep on. Naturally moisture-wicking and silky smooth, they feel amazing after a long, hard day. They have extra deep pockets and extra corner bands to keep them from slipping off the mattress. What I like best about the sheets is how they feel. They’re softer than cotton, have a gorgeous sheen, and a high-quality feel that makes the sleep experience better.

NYP Review: “I’m a hot sleeper, and have tested out several fabrics in search of a cooler night’s sleep. Luxome’s sheets are 100% Viscose from Bamboo — rather than a cheap blend — and this makes all the difference in keeping the fabric cool and breathable,” explained Meaghan Seward, senior strategist, audience optimization & discovery. “When I put the fresh sheets on my bed, I was delighted to find the extra-deep pockets making it so easy to make the bed, and the flat sheet seemed extra long and wide, even on my king bed — anyone sleeping alongside a partner knows this is a major plus. The bamboo fabric is designed to be naturally thermal-regulating, which is a blessing for hot sleepers. The silky, cool-to-the-touch feel helps me fall asleep and stay asleep. Every night I look forward to getting into bed and having another great night’s sleep, thanks to these sheets.”

Materials: 100% Viscose from Bamboo | Colors: 11 options | Size Options: Twin, Twin XL sheets, Full, Queen, King, California King, Split King

Saatva’s organic cotton sheets are an incredible option that will make getting out of bed even harder — but who said that’s a bad thing, right?  They’re made of 100% GOTS-certified organic cotton that’s silky-soft and features a 300 thread count sateen weave that gets softer with every wash.

Customers are saying: “I’m by no means an experienced sheet ‘buyer,’ but I will say this: Saatva sheets are an excellent addition to our bed. They are soft to the touch and help keep us cool,” said one reviewer. “I generally sleep cool, but my fiancé sleeps hot, and these sheets work well for both of us. Not much more to say other than I’m very glad I spent the extra money…definitely worth every penny. And the packaging was incredible! This was truly a luxury experience.”

Materials: 100% certified organic cotton | Colors: 3 options | Size Options: Twin, XL Twin, Full, Queen, King, California King, Split King, Upper Flex Queen, Upper Flex King

Brooklinen’s bestselling Luxe Sheets have quite literally taken over the internet since the brand released the set in April 2014 — and the review count certainly proves that! They come in over a dozen different colors and patterns and the set includes a flat sheet, two pillowcases, one fitted sheet, and a duvet with side ties.

In terms of comfort, the sheets are made of 480 thread count long-staple cotton, which means they’re soft and cool. They also have a glossy, almost silky sheen, giving them a more luxurious look. I love how they’re available in a variety of colors and that a duvet cover is also included. Many other customers agree, too.

NYP Review: “The Luxe Core Sheet Set looks clean and is so comfortable to sink into at night,” said Victoria McDonnell, content strategist and commerce journalist on The Post’s Shopping team. ” For hot and cool sleepers alike, I would say the Luxe Core Sheet Set is a great, light, and airy option. I like to sleep with a million and one blankets and shorts, practically all year round, and Brooklinen delivers an exceptional, sound sleep. So much so, it’s a struggle to leave bed some mornings.”

Materials: Long-staple cotton | Colors: 13 options | Size Options: Twin, XL Twin, Full, Queen, King, California King

Amazon is always a good place to find new bedding, especially bed sheets. This set from Amazon Basics has amazing reviews and is soft and light. My favorite part is that the set is under $50. It also comes in lots of different colors and is easy to care for.

“I was skeptical about these sheets because of the price point. It seems impossible to find any sheet set under $20 that is comfortable to sleep on,” says Salemann, who tested and reviewed the bed sheets. “However, I went ahead and tried these out and have never looked back. They came out of the wash without any fuzz, feeling smooth and soft to the touch. I’ve even noticed my skin is breaking out less with these sheets – probably because the microfiber is super gentle. My favorite part about them is how lightweight they are compared to some other brands I’ve tried. I don’t like to feel weighed down when I am sleeping, so these are perfect for me.”

Materials: Polyester | Colors: 30 options | Size Options: Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King

Don’t let the lack of reviews fool you. Anything from LilySilk is good! And if you’re someone who cares about your hair or doesn’t like overheating at night, you may want to invest in these nice silk sheets. Naturally thermoregulating and hypoallergenic, sleeping on these is like being on the coolest, smoothest cloud. Or, something like that. The sheets are seamless, too, and come in some really gorgeous colors, including lavender, dark teal, and taupe.

Customers are saying: “I am beyond obsessed with these sheets… How great is it that they offer different “qualities” (per se) of silk? If you are a beginner like me (I’ve had two silk pillowcases from other brands and that was all I’ve ever known) … and you’re just starting to branch out into the silk world? Getting 19 momme over the 22 or 25 is definitely the way to go. You can test out the waters without spending double.,. I’ve heard silk dyes really well so if you’re choosing a color, it’ll be very opaque and beautiful.. true to color (for whatever color you pick). Could only say great things.”

Materials: 100% mulberry silk | Colors: 8 options | Size Options: Twin, Full, Queen, King, California King

New York Post Review: “If you have a thick mattress or use a plush topper, you know the struggle of sheets that barely cover the sides. These Sleep Number pockets are incredibly generous, staying tucked and tight without any of the daily re-tucking that usually comes with standard cotton sets. It gives the bed a tailored, hotel-quality look that doesn’t move until you’re ready to change the laundry.

I own a Sleep Number mattress and love it more than any other mattress I’ve ever slept on, but it also means that my FlexTop King requires very specific sheets that only Sleep Number sells.

I’ve fallen in love with an assortment of Sleep Number sheets, but I’ve really grown to enjoy the Ultrasoft Knit set over the past few weeks.

The fabric has maintained its elasticity, with no pilling or thinning. The oversized flat sheet is a subtle, luxurious touch, providing plenty of overhang so you aren’t fighting your partner for covers in the middle of the night, in theory, but I am still fighting mine, who has a tuck-and-roll approach to sleeping.

I have been sleeping on these sheets for 3-4 weeks now and have fallen in love with how soft they are. I especially appreciate the stretch-like material in the fabric.” —  Emma Sutton-Williams, commerce reporter

What’s included? One oversized flat sheet, one fitted sheet (Split King and Split California King sets contain two fitted sheets), and two pillowcases (Twin and Twin XL include one pillowcase).

Materials: | Colors: 4 options | Size Options: Twin, XL Twin, Full, Queen, King, California King, Split King, Split California King, FlexTop King, FlexTop California King

Quince’s viscose sheets are crafted from organic bamboo, which is one of the planet’s most resource-efficient materials. They don’t just boast that luxury silky feel, but also keep you cool in the summer months. The material does lend a small amount of shine, for that hotel-quality look.

NYP Review: “They’re under $100, which, in my opinion, is reasonable. More importantly (and impressively), they’re high quality,” shared Commerce Deputy Editor, Holly J Coley. “They’re silky smooth, cool to the touch, and naturally hypoallergenic, which I love because I have sensitive skin. I love the glossy sheen they have, which makes them look far more expensive than they actually are. Although they’re prone to wrinkling, I love them, especially during the hotter months. And when I think about them also being organic…insert mind-blown emoji,” Coley concluded.

Other high-quality organic sheets we recommend are made by Boll & Branch.

Materials: Bamboo | Colors: 11 options | Size Options: Twin, Full, Queen, King, California King

Cozy Earth’s Bamboo Sheet Set is made of 100% premium viscose from bamboo. Featuring an oversized fit and gentle drape, the temperature-regulating sheets are uniquely soft and only get softer with every wash. Like many people, I like to reach for sustainable options when I can, and bamboo is definitely like. Many reviews rave about the softness of this sheet set, using words like “butter” and “cloud-like” to describe them. In fact, 97% of folks who’ve purchased on Cozy Earth would recommend them. Best of all, because the sheets are available in Split King, they could work for an adjustable bed! Available in 16 colors.

NYP Review: “I immediately loved the silky-smooth texture of these sheets — and after sleeping on them for several months, I can attest that they did in fact only get softer over time,” noted Hannah Southwick, Page Six commerce associate editor. “Perhaps more importantly, though, the breathable bamboo knit has kept me from overheating on hot nights (something traditional cotton bedding has never accomplished, in my experience). While I historically haven’t splurged as much in the bedding department, this luxe-feeling fabric has me questioning how I ever lived without it.”

Materials: 100% premium viscose from bamboo | Colors: 17 options | Size Options: Twin, XL Twin, Full, Queen, King, California King, Split King

The Buffy Breeze Sheet Set is a favorite of shopping editors everywhere. The premium soft sheets are made from eucalyptus for a breathable sleep, but they have a substantial weight to make them durable. An awesome choice for those with sensitive skin, they hold up wash after wash, remaining soft and cool to the touch. They’re available in more than a dozen colors, but be warned — this sheet set is often out of stock. Yes, they’re that popular.

Materials: Lyocell | Colors: 31 options | Size Options: Twin, Twin XL sheets, Full, Queen, King, California King, Split King

Parachute’s Percale Venice Sheets are another option that is well-reviewed. They’re crafted in Portugal from 100% premium, certified long-staple Egyptian cotton, which is lightweight and durable with a crisp finish that ages well. Although some dislike the crinkly sound percale sheets make, I don’t mind it, and neither do many others. In an odd way, it adds to the “fresh” feeling these naturally cooling sheets have. They also feel lovely against the skin, as one reviewer pointed out. They said, “Terrific. Study soft fabric. Great size with elastic that holds the sheet in place. Love them.”

Customers are saying: “I really do like these sheets. This is my second set. The fabric is smooth and soft to the touch without the crinkly paper sound of some percale sheets. Yes, there is some minor wrinkling but I remove them from the dryer while still damp and either put them directly on the bed or fold them for later use. I’m a hot sleeper, and these do help much more than sateen sheets.”

Materials: 100% long-staple Egyptian cotton | Colors: 7 options | Size Options: Full, Queen, King, California King

Woven from premium extra-long staple cotton in a 400-thread count, single ply, sateen weave, these white sheets will feel beautifully smooth and silky against your skin. It’s simple yet classic hem gives it crisp and clean lines for a timeless look for your bedroom.

Personally, I love the classic look and feel of these bedsheets. Let’s be real, how can you go wrong with long-staple cotton? However, I do want to note that the return policy is on the stringent side. You’ll have 30 days to return, and the sheets can’t be washed or used. Given that most defects are discovered after doing those two things, the policy is on the pointless side. Still, the bedding is lovely and we don’t see much reason for returning other than you’ve ordered the wrong size.

Materials: 100% cotton sateen | Colors: 1 option | Size Options: Twin, XL Twin, Full, Queen, King, California King, Split King

If you’ve splurged on an adjustable bed, we know you’re serious about your sleep quality. Hundreds of people think the percale weave of this bed sheet is dreamy, and I agree with them. It’s crisp and soft, having a similar feel to hotel sheets. I also like that it comes in lot of color options, because just plain white gets boring.

Although some customers report wrinkles and issues with the fit, the overall feedback is positive. The sheets have a long side and short tags, as well as 360-degree elastic to prevent the edges from slipping off. As long as your mattress is up to 15 inches, you should be good. One reviewer loved the sheets so much that she was planning to order them for her child’s birthday.

Customers are saying: “Love my OneBed Queen-size sheet set. I absolutely love the quality of the sheets. They’re nice, thick, and soft. It was very easy to make my bed in 1 minute. I’m ordering another one for my daughter’s birthday.”

Materials: 100% organic cotton | Colors: 11 options | Size Options: Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King, California King

Magic Linen (a brand loved by Meghan Markle) is known for its white linen sheets, and according to reviews — you definitely don’t want to miss out on them!

Customers are saying: “These linen sheets are everything I hoped for and more,” said a reviewer. “They are beautiful in texture and appearance, and [they’re] husband and cat-approved too!”

“My sister encouraged me to try linen sheets for the best sleep. I was so used to soft cotton and satin that linen sounded less than appealing. [Boy], was I wrong!” said another reviewer. “My husband and I love these sheets — they are soft, warm, and light (yes, both). We will never go back to cotton.”

Materials: Microfiber | Colors: 26 options | Size Options: Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King, California King, Split King

The Eddie Bauer Montlake Plaid Flannel Sheet Set has style with cozy comfort, making it a perfect choice for cold-weather nights. Made from 100% cotton flannel and brushed three times for extra softness, these sheets offer warmth without the weight.

The classic red and khaki plaid design adds a rustic, inviting touch to any bedroom décor, while the deep-pocket fitted sheet with all-around elastic ensures a secure fit on mattresses up to 18 inches thick. Durable, breathable, and OEKO-TEX certified, this set includes a fitted sheet, flat sheet, and two standard pillowcases, all machine washable for easy care.

Materials: 100% Cotton Flannel | Colors: 12 Plaid & Stripe Options | Size Options: Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King

According to Sun, textile expert and founder of Crane & Canopy, there are a variety of materials that make quality bed sheets.

The best bed sheets depend on your personal preferences and sleeping needs, but here are a few materials to consider before buying.

Sun recommends to “opt for the highest-quality sheets within your price range but don’t break the bank, or worry too much about ultra-high thread counts. A higher thread count is not necessarily better!”

“The ideal thread count is typically 300 to 430 and for a premium material like 100% cotton, this will provide the best quality, feel and durability for the price. Choose natural fibers and avoid polyester and polyester-cotton.

“The ideal thread count is typically 300 to 430,” explains Sun. “For a premium material like 100% cotton, this will provide the best quality, feel and durability for the price. Choose natural fibers and avoid polyester and polyester-cotton.”

Although thread count is important, it shouldn’t be the only determining factor. Weave and finishing should also be considered, as well as design features that help the sheet to fit snugly against the mattress.

To have a better understanding of thread counts, here is what each range means:

Figuring out the best sheets for you will be entirely dependent on your specific needs. Also, consider the time of year you’ll be enjoying the bedding. For example, sheets with a high thread count are heavier and best for colder months but not for summer. And if you’re looking for warm sheets, check out our best flannel roundup.

Also consider if you’re a hot sleeper or not. For those who run warm, it’s advisable to purchase sheets made of silk, bamboo or cotton with a lower thread count.

For hot sleepers, we love a few different sheet sets, including the Bamboo Sheets from Cozy Earth ($272). They’re not flimsy but are still very breathable. Reviewers rave about their softness, plus they come in a variety of colors and sizes.

Another brand we like for its cooling sheets is Luxome. Specifically, the Luxury Sheet Set ($145), which is made from 100% viscose derived from bamboo. Besides being naturally thermoregulating and moisture-wicking, the sheets have an almost silky texture that feels incredible!

For something that works all year long, we look to Brooklinen. Its Luxe Sateen Hardcore Sleep Bundle is a favorite of editors and our readers. It has a 480 thread count, so it’s light but not too light. It’s also strong enough to hold up through weekly washes, tossing and turning — you know, the basics.

Ultimately, the best sheets are the ones that help a person sleep the best. It’s likely that you’ll want multiple types to switch between as the seasons change. The good news is that there are plenty out there to choose from. And now, thanks to this roundup, you know which ones are worth adding to your cart from fast shipping at Target to additional add-ons like My Pillow, comforters and more, you’ll be sure to find something for you.

For over 200 years, the New York Post has been America’s go-to source for bold news, engaging stories, in-depth reporting, and now, insightful shopping guidance. We’re not just thorough reporters – we sift through mountains of information, test and compare products, and consult experts on any topics we aren’t already schooled specialists in to deliver useful, realistic product recommendations based on our extensive and hands-on analysis. Here at The Post, we’re known for being brutally honest – we clearly label partnership content, and whether we receive anything from affiliate links, so you always know where we stand. We routinely update content to reflect current research and expert advice, provide context (and wit) and ensure our links work. Please note that deals can expire, and all prices are subject to change.

پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. فصل پوسیدگی تخت تقریباً به پایان رسیده است، و معنی آن را می‌دانید. با توجه به اینکه هوا در حال خنک‌تر شدن است، روزها کوتاه‌تر می‌شوند و ساعات استراحت (باید!) طولانی‌تر می‌شوند، ممکن است زمان آن رسیده باشد که ملحفه‌های تخت خود را تازه کنید. واقعاً هیچ چیز بهتر از پریدن به رختخواب با یک جفت ملحفه جدید نیست. پیدا کردن مجموعه مناسب برای شماست که می تواند چالش باشد. دنیس چان، مدیر محصولات خرده فروشی هتل ها و استراحتگاه های Four Seasons، گفت: «مجموعه مناسب ملحفه زمینه را برای کل تجربه خواب شما فراهم می کند. چان به The Post گفت: «زمانی که تخت خواب خود را انتخاب می کنید، سرمایه گذاری روی دوام، طراحی و احساس همه چیز را تغییر می دهد. ملافه‌های فوق‌العاده در برابر پوست شما احساس فوق‌العاده‌ای خواهند داشت و با حفظ کیفیت شبانه‌روز در آزمون زمان مقاومت خواهند کرد. ورق ها نیز باید مکمل سبک شخصی شما باشند. به هر حال تخت، مرکز اتاق شماست!»
طی دو سال گذشته، تیم Post Wanted به طور جمعی ده ها ملحفه را آزمایش کرده است. این 14 موردی هستند که فکر می کنیم ارزش پول شما را در سال 2026 دارند.  چه به دنبال چیزی در ساتن مانند ملحفه ساتن لوکس از بروکلین باشید و چه چیزی نرم، پایدار و خنک مانند ملحفه‌های اکالیپتوس بافی را ترجیح می‌دهید، ما ست‌ها و مارک‌هایی را پیدا کرده‌ایم که شما و تشک‌تان را پوشانده‌اند. اگر به ملحفه های خنک کننده بیشتر علاقه دارید، بررسی ما را در مورد بهترین ورق های خنک کننده ما بررسی کنید. برای اینکه بدانید هنگام آزمایش و بررسی ملحفه تخت باید به دنبال چه چیزی باشید.

Kristen Bell revealed husband Dax Shepard flirts with her by complimenting other people’s looks.

“You’ll pull out a feature,” Bell, 46, said to Shepard, 51, on Monday’s episode of his “Armchair Expert” podcast. “That’s how I know you’re flirting with me a lot.”

The “Nobody Wants This” actress explained that when the couple is out to dinner, “there’s a couple things Dax does where he doesn’t have to look up and wink at me, but I know that he’s just being the best boy.”

Shepard, according to Bell, will tell their waiter or waitress, “Wow, you have incredible eyelashes, gorgeous eyes. Great, great job.”

Their confession shocked Bell’s co-stars and Shepard’s co-host, Monica Padman, who insisted that Shepard is “flirting” with the waitress, and not his wife, in those situations.

“But that’s flirting with me,” Bell disagreed, “because he just made someone else feel good.”

The “Veronica Mars” alum argued that Shepard will likely never speak to that waitress again, so she doesn’t get offended when he “actively smiles at people and gives them compliments.”

Shepard, for his part, insisted there’s one physical attribute in others that he’ll never compliment.

“I don’t do lips,” he said. “That’s crazy.”

Bell then clarified that Shepard has “never done anything that’s felt even borderline” crossing the line in his interactions with strangers.

“Like, you’ll point out if someone has great eyebrows or great cheekbones,” she said, noting that when Shepard met their friend Heather, he told her she has “the eyebrows of the century.’”

“I was the only who said it,” Shepard explained.

That reason, Bell said, is why she gets “fluttery inside” from Shepard.

“That’s why it gives me butterflies because everyone saw it,” she shared. “He’s the only one that said it. Maybe she hadn’t had a compliment today. And I’m with the guy that’s pouring compliments on people, making people feel good.”

Bell and Shepard, who got married in October 2013, and share two children, have made headlines for their unconventional confessions about their relationship.

They’ve talked about going to couples therapy since the beginning, not having a prenup, and allowing their daughters Lincoln, 13, and Delta, 11, to drink non-alcoholic beer.

On their 12th wedding anniversary last year, Bell joked about Shepard promising he “would never kill [her].”

“A lot of men have killed their wives at a certain point. Even though I’m heavily incentivized to kill you, I never would.’ ❤️,'” she wrote on Instagram.

After Bell was slammed for the “unbelievably tone-deaf” message, Shepard insisted he had “no clue” the post sparked such a strong reaction on the internet.

بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. کریستن بل نشان داد که شوهرش داکس شپرد با تعریف و تمجید از ظاهر دیگران با او معاشقه می کند. بل 46 ساله به شپرد 51 ساله در اپیزود روز دوشنبه پادکست خود "کارشناس صندلی صندلی" گفت: "شما یک ویژگی را حذف خواهید کرد." "اینطوری میدونم که زیاد با من معاشقه میکنی." بازیگر «هیچ کس این را نمی‌خواهد» توضیح داد که وقتی این زوج برای شام بیرون می‌روند، «دکس چند کار انجام می‌دهد که مجبور نیست سرش را بلند کند و به من چشمک بزند، اما من می‌دانم که او بهترین پسر است.»
به گفته بل، شپرد به پیشخدمت یا پیشخدمت خود می گوید: "وای، تو مژه های باورنکردنی، چشمان زیبایی داری. عالی، کار عالی." اعتراف آن‌ها همبازی‌های بل و مونیکا پدمن، مجری شریک شپرد را شوکه کرد، که اصرار داشت که شپرد در آن موقعیت‌ها با پیشخدمت «لاستیک» می‌شود، نه با همسرش. بل مخالفت کرد، «اما این با من معاشقه است، زیرا او فقط باعث می‌شود که شخص دیگری احساس خوبی داشته باشد». دانشمند "ورونیکا مارس" استدلال کرد که شپرد احتمالاً دیگر هرگز با آن پیشخدمت صحبت نخواهد کرد، بنابراین وقتی او "فعالانه به مردم لبخند می زند و آنها را تعریف می کند" آزرده نمی شود.
شپرد، به نوبه خود، اصرار داشت که یک ویژگی فیزیکی در دیگران وجود دارد که هرگز از آن تعریف نمی‌کند. او گفت: «من لب نمی‌زنم. "این دیوانه است." بل سپس توضیح داد که شپرد «هرگز کاری انجام نداده است که حتی مرزی به نظر می‌رسد» و در تعامل با غریبه‌ها از مرز عبور نکرده است.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

They were absolutely furry-ous.

A couple was left reeling after their dream marriage proposal was photobombed by a trio of people in animal costumes.

The TikTok clip, which boasts over 11 million views, shows the couple enjoying a picnic in a picturesque park, complete with a blanket adorned with candles like something out of a romance film.

The aspiring groom drops to one knee and places a ring on the finger of his blushing bride-to-be.

However, just as she accepts and the soon-to-be man and wife embrace, three goofy-looking critter cosplayers stroll past, taking the air out of their Hallmark moment.

“POV: You’re capturing your best friend’s engagement and NOW is the time the FURRIES decide to walk by,” read the caption.

They were referring to the subculture of people who have a fascination with anthropomorphic animals — fictitious creatures that walk, talk, and even look like people (read: Disney’s 1973 animated “Robin Hood”).

These unofficial mascots bring their pastime to life via drawings, writing, and donning extravagant “fursuits” that cost thousands of dollars.

Viewers were taken aback by the critter-mimicking wedding crashers with one writing, “I’d be fuming.”

“This is genuinely my worst nightmare,” said another, while a third quipped, “Omg I’d be so furryious.”

However, others saw the humor in it. “If I got photobombed by a bunch of furries during my engagement I’d laugh so hard and cherish it forever ngl,” declared one commenter.

Coincidentally, a member of the community has since identified the furries in question.

“THATS MY FRIENDS LOL!!” they wrote. “I WAS ALSO THERE BUT NOT IN THIS VID!! HAPPY ENGAGEMENT I WISH YALL THE BEST!!”

Another blamed the accidental cameo on the fact that they couldn’t see very well out of the giant animal heads.

“As you can see we have a huge blind spot smack in the middle,” they wrote alongside a POV photo taken from inside the getup. “That’s why so many have handlers to guide them through crowded conventions.”

Unfortunately, Furries have been accused of more than proposal photobombs.

The pastime is often viewed as a form of sexual fetish, even though only a small subset claim they partake for X-rated reasons.

Meanwhile, in 2022, members of the subculture faced blowback after rumors swirled that a Michigan school put a litter box in one of its bathrooms for kids who identify as cats.

This claim sparked concerns among parents with one deeming it part of a nationwide “agenda being pushed” within the education system.

While the rumor was subsequently debunked, furries nonetheless felt ostracized.

“It is a shame that the furry community still endures (some) negative media portrayals and public misperception as deviants because the truth of this remarkable and resilient community is far more interesting,” Dr. Sharon E. Roberts, associate professor at the University of Waterloo and a co-founder of the International Anthropomorphic Research Project, previously told The Post.

پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. آنها کاملاً خزدار بودند. زوجی پس از اینکه پیشنهاد ازدواج رویایی آنها توسط سه نفر از افراد با لباس حیوانات بمباران شد، متحیر شدند. کلیپ TikTok که بیش از 11 میلیون بازدید دارد، زوج را در حال لذت بردن از یک پیک نیک در یک پارک زیبا نشان می دهد که با پتویی عاشقانه مانند چیزی تزئین شده است. داماد مشتاق روی یک زانو می‌افتد و حلقه‌ای را روی انگشت عروس سرخ‌شده‌اش می‌گذارد. با این حال، درست همانطور که او می‌پذیرد و زن و مرد به زودی در آغوش می‌گیرند، سه همبازی مخلوق با ظاهری احمق قدم می‌زنند و هوا را از لحظه‌ی شاخص خود خارج می‌کنند. توسط، شرح زیر را بخوانید. آنها به خرده فرهنگ افرادی اشاره داشتند که شیفتگی به حیوانات انسان نما دارند - موجودات خیالی که راه می روند، صحبت می کنند و حتی شبیه مردم هستند (بخوانید: انیمیشن «رابین هود» محصول 1973 دیزنی). تماشاگران از تماشاگران عروسی شبیه به مخلوقات با یک نوشته متعجب شدند: «من دود می‌کنم».
یکی دیگر گفت: "این واقعاً بدترین کابوس من است" در حالی که سومی با کنایه گفت: "اوه من خیلی عصبانی خواهم شد."
با این حال، دیگران طنز را در آن دیدند. «اگر در دوران نامزدی‌ام توسط یک مشت پشمالو بمب‌گذاری شده باشم، خیلی می‌خندم و آن را برای همیشه گرامی می‌دارم.»

news.originalContent:
Tehran remains firm on demands despite diplomatic urgency to prevent escalation in the ongoing US-Israeli conflict.

As regional powers step up diplomatic efforts to prevent another escalation in the eight-month United States-Israel war on Iran, Tehran is showing little sign of backing down from its red lines.

The announcement by China on Tuesday that Beijing will be sending an envoy to relevant countries in the region soon to help avoid another round of escalation highlights the growing urgency of finding a peaceful solution to a conflict that has disrupted global energy markets and spilled over across the region.

On Monday, senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkiye – the three nations which signed the Mecca defence pact in August – met with high-ranking Iranian officials, promising to continue discussions related to “peace and security” in the region.

However, Tehran appears determined not to budge on its demands, particularly as it holds considerable leverage over the future of maritime trade in the Strait of Hormuz, through which one-fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas (LNG) were shipped before the war.

“Iran’s priority is not simply to secure another ceasefire, but to end the war permanently and establish deterrence so that the cycle of military attacks by the US and Israel does not keep repeating itself,” Negar Mortazavi, editor and host of The Iran Podcast, told Al Jazeera.

Tehran continues to insist on sanctions relief, an end to the US naval blockade on its ports in the Gulf and guarantees that the US will not renew attacks, in exchange for helping to resume normal traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. The US wants Iran to give up more before a final peace settlement is negotiated – including making concessions about its nuclear programme.

Experts say Iran’s current calculations are being driven by several factors, including its deep distrust of Washington – which has launched strikes on Iran three times since June 2025 while conducting talks – the belief that continued economic pressure could force more attractive US concessions, and much-anticipated elections in Israel and the US this week and next.

At the heart of Iran’s position is a belief that previous diplomatic efforts have failed to provide sufficient protection against renewed US and Israeli attacks. The US and Israel launched the first strikes of the war on February 28, just as peace talks were ongoing in Oman. Last year, Israel launched its 12-day war on Iran in June, which the US joined.

Pakistan and Qatar helped broker a memorandum of understanding in June this year aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz, ending the US blockade of Iranian ports and laying down the conditions for the start of negotiations over Iran’s nuclear programme.

But the arrangement quickly unravelled as both sides resumed attacks, leading to sustained US attacks on Iran for several weeks in July, followed by retaliatory strikes from Iran on US military assets and energy infrastructure in neighbouring Gulf countries, as well as in Jordan.

Sina Toossi, a senior non-resident fellow at the Center for International Policy (CIP), said the failure of that arrangement had hardened Tehran’s position.

“Iran believes previous negotiations and ceasefire arrangements failed to protect it from renewed military attacks, and it is therefore seeking more tangible and durable guarantees,” he told Al Jazeera.

US President Donald Trump, meanwhile, has remained ambiguous over what course of action he will take in the near future. “My question is, do I make a deal with them or do I finish them off?” Trump told reporters on Sunday. He had previously said attacks on Iran would not take place until after the US midterms on November 3.

Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, said last week that the country’s armed forces were prepared to respond to any new attacks, including by invading Tehran’s neighbours and hitting bases used in US military operations as part of its new “offensive” strategy in its war with the US.

He also said Iran would only reopen the Strait of Hormuz and begin peace talks once Washington took concrete steps to rebuild trust, including meeting Iran’s latest set of conditions – suspending sanctions, unfreezing Iranian assets, lifting the US naval blockade of Iranian ports and giving concrete assurances that it will not begin strikes again.

The US midterms next week, when all 435 House of Representatives seats and 35 of the 100 Senate seats will be up for grabs, will determine which party has control of the US Congress for the final two years of Trump’s presidency. The war, already deeply unpopular with Americans, is becoming an increasingly contentious domestic issue.

A Reuters/Ipsos survey earlier this month found just 34 percent of Americans approved of Trump’s handling of the conflict – his lowest rating during either of his presidential terms. Republican majorities in both houses of Congress are already wafer-thin – at 53-47 (including two independents who vote with Democrats) in the Senate and 218-214 in the House.

The war has also driven up energy prices – particularly diesel, which has nearly doubled in price, causing a major burden for farmers and small businesses – adding to concerns about inflation and affordability that are dominating the election campaign.

Some reports citing Iranian officials say Tehran may be deliberately prolonging negotiations to deny Trump any sort of political victory before the elections.

A Republican setback could further constrain Trump’s room for manoeuvre, particularly if Democrats gain congressional control and increase scrutiny of the administration’s conduct of the war.

“Tehran wants to teach a lesson to Washington, including future American presidents, that attacking Iran comes with a high price,” analyst Mortazavi said.

“Its deterrence strategy is multilayered, aimed at imposing military, economic and political costs that extend well beyond the battlefield.”

Before the US midterms is Israel’s election on Tuesday, which introduces another dimension to Iran’s calculations. A defeat for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu could complicate renewing joint attacks with the US on Iran, as experts say he was the main force behind Trump greenlighting the war.

While some believe an opposition victory led by former military chief Gadi Eisenkot could potentially ease regional tensions, Netanyahu’s removal would not necessarily translate into a softer Israeli position towards Iran.

Eisenkot is himself a former military chief, and has repeatedly expressed concerns about Iran’s nuclear programme and regional influence.

Nevertheless, Mortazavi said, while Iranian officials are closely watching the political consequences of the war for both Washington and Israel, they recognise the danger of renewed escalation after the elections, “making a durable diplomatic settlement even more urgent”.

Iran’s control over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz remains one of its strongest bargaining chips.

The waterway carried about one-fifth of the world’s energy supplies before the war began on February 28, giving Tehran considerable leverage over global oil markets.

October has recorded the highest number of attacks on commercial shipping around Hormuz, according to data collected by the Washington Institute for Near East Policy.

Brent crude surged above $117 a barrel last week – compared with about $72 pre-war – following Iranian attacks on tankers, while shipping through the strait remains nowhere near pre-war levels.

Chris Beauchamp, chief market analyst at IG Group, said he believes Iran is deliberately exploiting this economic pressure as part of a wider contest of endurance with Washington.

“They know they are in an attritional race with the US to see who breaks first,” Beauchamp told Al Jazeera. “For now, however, they are happy to keep attacking shipping to push prices higher.”

The latest diplomatic initiative reflects a growing concern among regional powers about the consequences of another round of fighting.

Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkiye agreed with Iranian officials on Monday to continue discussions about regional peace and security, amid fears that the conflict could escalate again.

The talks in Tehran come amid heightened regional tensions following weeks of attacks on Saudi Arabia by Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthi rebels, who are also engaged in a conflict with forces loyal to Yemen’s internationally recognised, Saudi-backed government.

Pakistan and Turkiye maintain close strategic ties with Saudi Arabia and have committed to supporting Riyadh militarily under the recently established Mecca Joint Defence Agreement between the three Muslim-majority nations.

Political analyst Rami Khouri, a nonresident fellow at the Arab Center in Washington DC, said the meeting had several objectives, some more immediate than others.

“The most immediate goal: to de-escalate and to try to return to the diplomatic process, to have a permanent ceasefire, and then define the issues and address them with much stronger mediation, supported by these three countries [Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkiye] and maybe others,” Khouri told Al Jazeera.

He added that talks could mark the beginning of a shift away from a regional security order dominated by Washington, towards one in which Middle East countries and other regional nations can exercise greater influence.

Meanwhile, CIP’s Toossi said regional powers are increasingly recognising that their own security cannot be separated from that of Iran, despite their differences with Tehran.

“It will be difficult to stabilise Yemen while the wider US-Iran confrontation continues, just as it will be difficult to reach a durable settlement with Iran while regional military escalation remains a constant threat,” he said.

Ultimately, however, the biggest obstacle remains Iran’s lack of trust in Washington, Iran Podcast host Mortazavi said.

“After two wars, Tehran is deeply sceptical of American commitments and wants concrete guarantees that any agreement will not simply become another temporary pause before the next attack,” she said.

“Iran is willing to negotiate and has already demonstrated flexibility by presenting a proposal to end the war. But Tehran believes it retains significant leverage, particularly in the Strait of Hormuz, and will not surrender that leverage under military or economic pressure. The goal is a permanent end to the war, not another temporary ceasefire that leaves the underlying conflict unresolved.”
news.content: تهران علیرغم فوریت دیپلماتیک برای جلوگیری از تشدید تنش در مناقشه ادامه دار آمریکا و اسرائیل، همچنان بر خواسته های خود ثابت قدم است. در حالی که قدرت های منطقه ای تلاش های دیپلماتیک خود را برای جلوگیری از تشدید مجدد در جنگ هشت ماهه ایالات متحده و اسرائیل علیه ایران افزایش می دهند، تهران نشانه کمی از عقب نشینی از خطوط قرمز خود نشان می دهد. اعلام روز سه‌شنبه چین مبنی بر اینکه پکن به زودی نماینده‌ای را به کشورهای مرتبط در منطقه می‌فرستد تا از دور دیگری از تشدید تنش جلوگیری کند، ضرورت فزاینده یافتن راه‌حلی صلح‌آمیز برای درگیری را که بازارهای جهانی انرژی را مختل کرده و در سراسر منطقه سرایت کرده است، نشان می‌دهد. روز دوشنبه، مقامات ارشد عربستان سعودی، پاکستان و ترکیه - سه کشوری که پیمان دفاعی مکه را در ماه اوت امضا کردند - با مقامات بلندپایه ایران دیدار کردند و قول دادند که گفتگوهای مربوط به "صلح و امنیت" در منطقه را ادامه دهند. با این حال، به نظر می‌رسد تهران مصمم است از خواسته‌های خود تسلیم نشود، به‌ویژه که اهرم قابل‌توجهی بر آینده تجارت دریایی در تنگه هرمز دارد، که از طریق آن یک پنجم نفت و گاز طبیعی مایع (LNG) جهانی قبل از جنگ حمل می‌شد. نگار مرتضوی، سردبیر و مجری پادکست ایران، به الجزیره گفت: «اولویت ایران صرفاً تأمین آتش‌بس دیگر نیست، بلکه پایان دائمی جنگ و ایجاد بازدارندگی است تا چرخه حملات نظامی آمریکا و اسرائیل تکرار نشود».

Almost 45 percent of Israeli voters had cast a ballot by mid-afternoon on Tuesday, according to Israel’s Central Elections Committee, marking the highest election turnout by 2pm (12:00 GMT) in 50 years.

The figure was 6 percent higher than at the same time in the last elections in 2022.

Mitchell Barak, a pollster and former aide to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, told Al Jazeera that voter turnout “is really high and that’s good”.

“I think … it will probably pass its historic peak in ‘73 – when Israel was also involved in a huge war – so draw what conclusion from that you will,” he added.

The election is largely seen as a referendum on Netanyahu’s handling of the October 7, 2023 Hamas-led attacks and the wars that followed, the most intense period of combat for Israel since the 1973 surprise military campaign by Egypt and Syria.

“Those numbers are going to help the incumbent parties,” Barak said, “as the 3.25 percent threshold a party needs to get into the Knesset remains, the number of votes you need to meet that threshold increases dramatically.”

Israeli officials noted that several polling stations had faced exceptionally long lines, which were attributed to high voter turnout despite rainy and blustery weather in parts of the country, and a flood warning in some areas.

In a message more than five hours after polls opened, Netanyahu urged supporters to vote, saying turnout was high among his opponents on the left and among Palestinian citizens of Israel, about a fifth of the population.

“We need it to be high too. You all need to stream to the polls,” he said. “This is a fateful moment.”

Netanyahu had repeatedly warned supporters of the prospect of high turnout among Palestinian citizens in Israel ahead of the vote, seeking to mobilise his base under the slogan “the right or Palestine”.

Those voters were casting ballots in “unprecedented” numbers, Palestinian candidate Ahmed Tibi said.

Netanyahu and his main rival Gadi Eisenkot have ruled out partnering with Arab parties, citing a lack of shared values, although some possible scenarios envision them propping up a minority government to ensure Netanyahu is removed from office.

Meanwhile, an Israeli rights group has filed a complaint with the country’s election commission warning that widespread delays could be suppressing the vote among Israeli Palestinians.

Though delays could be a result of high voter turnout, the Association for Civil Rights in Israel (ACRI) said in its complaint to the Central Elections Committee that delays had been reported in at least 18 communities. It asked the committee to investigate “whether these delays are deliberate.”

The ACRI also reported “a large presence” of police and National Guard officers at a polling station in the Negev Desert, raising concerns that officers were using crowd control as a pretext to prevent people from entering to vote.

تقریباً 45 درصد از اسرائیلی‌ها تا اواسط بعد از ظهر رای داده بودند، اما سؤالاتی در مورد سرکوب احتمالی رأی‌دهندگان در شهرهای عربی مطرح شده است. طبق اعلام کمیته مرکزی انتخابات اسرائیل، تقریباً 45 درصد از رای‌دهندگان اسرائیلی تا اواسط بعد از ظهر روز سه‌شنبه رای داده بودند که بیشترین میزان مشارکت در انتخابات در ساعت 6:00:00 G. درصد بالاتر از زمان مشابه در آخرین انتخابات سال 2022 است. میچل باراک، یک نظرسنجی و دستیار سابق نخست وزیر بنیامین نتانیاهو، به الجزیره گفت که مشارکت در رای‌دهندگان «واقعاً بالا است و این خوب است». این انتخابات تا حد زیادی به عنوان یک همه پرسی در مورد نحوه مدیریت نتانیاهو در حملات 7 اکتبر 2023 به رهبری حماس و جنگ های پس از آن، شدیدترین دوره نبرد برای اسرائیل از زمان کارزار نظامی غافلگیرکننده مصر و سوریه در سال 1973 تلقی می شود. باراک گفت: «این اعداد به احزاب فعلی کمک خواهند کرد. آستانه ۲۵ درصدی که یک حزب برای ورود به کنست نیاز دارد، باقی می ماند، تعداد آرایی که برای رسیدن به آن آستانه به آن نیاز دارید، به طرز چشمگیری افزایش می یابد.
مقامات اسرائیلی خاطرنشان کردند که چندین شعبه رای گیری با صف های طولانی و استثنایی مواجه شده اند که به دلیل حضور بالای رأی دهندگان علیرغم هوای بارانی و طوفانی در بخش هایی از کشور و هشدار سیل در برخی مناطق، نسبت داده شده است.

news.originalContent:
Egyptian man held after crossing into Israel near Nitzana, his motive for the crossing still unknown.

Israel’s military has said that it detained an Egyptian civilian overnight after he crossed a border fence from Egyptian territory into Israel near Nitzana and that he was transferred to security forces for further questioning.

The military, which made the announcement on Tuesday, provided no additional details on the man’s identity, his motive or whether he was carrying anything at the time of his detention. Israeli state broadcaster Kan 11 reported that surveillance identified the suspect crossing the border and that troops were dispatched to the scene to arrest him.

Nitzana is a small community in southern Israel’s western Negev (Naqab) Desert, sitting directly adjacent to the Egyptian border opposite the Egyptian side’s Al-Awja area. The Nitzana border crossing, also known as the Eliav crossing, primarily handles cargo transport between the two countries rather than serving as a major passenger channel. It lies roughly 75km (47 miles) south of Beersheba.

The incident occurred as Israel maintains heightened alert levels along the Egyptian border. Israeli outlet Ynet reported that the military was treating the incident seriously and that it was under investigation.

Egyptian officials have not publicly commented on the detention.

Drug and arms smuggling takes place across the border between Egypt and Israel, neighbouring countries that signed a peace treaty in 1979 but whose relationship remains largely chilly.

Ynet reported the crossing came less than a year after Israel’s defence minister ordered the area adjacent to the Egyptian border declared a closed military zone and announced changes to open-fire regulations following earlier smuggling activity.

news.originalContent:
The Iran war and Donald Trump’s criticisms of allies have led countries in the Asia-Pacific region to recalibrate their calculations.

US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth will attend a Southeast Asian defence meeting this week alongside his counterparts from India, South Korea and Japan as Washington looks to solidify ties with the region after a year overshadowed by the fallout from the US-Israel war on Iran.

The meeting will bring together defence officials from the 11-member Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) plus eight of the bloc’s dialogue partners.

Australia, New Zealand, Russia and China are also expected to send representatives to the talks, which run from Wednesday to Thursday in the Philippines.

Known as the ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus), the meeting will be held alongside a parallel ASEAN members-only event for Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Timor-Leste, and Vietnam.

India is among the dialogue partners that will host bilateral meetings on the sidelines of ADMM-Plus to “review the ongoing defence ties and explore ways to further strengthen strategic partnerships”, according to state media.

William Yang, senior analyst for Northeast Asia at the International Crisis Group, told Al Jazeera that the focus will be on regional security concerns like Myanmar’s ongoing civil war and maritime disputes between ASEAN states and neighbouring China.

“The South China Sea dispute is going to be front and centre because the Philippines is the chair of this year’s summit,” he told Al Jazeera, adding that he expects Manila to push for ASEAN to finalise a code of conduct with China to outline how to approach maritime disputes and handle conflicts in the globally important waterway.

The Philippines, China, Vietnam, Malaysia, Brunei, and Taiwan all have overlapping territorial claims to the South China Sea, although Beijing claims most of it as domestic waters.

These disputes often leave Beijing at odds with its neighbours, and particularly Manila, as both sides claim the uninhabited Scarborough Shoal and parts of the Spratly Islands.

Tensions escalated sharply this month with at least “eight close encounters” in the South China Sea and nearby Luzon Strait, according to the US Naval Institute.

The spat turned into a war of words when Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan said Beijing could “easily win” a war with the Philippines, prompting a Philippine senator to call for his expulsion.

Beijing has yet to confirm whether Chinese Defence Minister Dong Jun will attend ADMM-Plus in person, but he could still make a last-minute appearance. The Chinese defence chief attended ADMM-Plus 2024 and 2025, according to Bonnie Glaser, managing director of the German Marshall Fund’s Indo-Pacific Program, and Hegseth’s presence could factor into Beijing’s calculations.

China and the US have spent the past year thawing their relationship. A face-to-face meeting between Hegseth and Dong could also lay the groundwork for two meetings between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping scheduled for later this year, following two previous meetings between Trump and Xi this year.

“It is certainly possible that he will attend again this year,” Glaser told Al Jazeera by email. “I would not be surprised if Dong meets with Secretary Hegseth, especially since China has repeatedly said that it attaches importance to strengthening crisis communications and preventing crises between the US and Chinese militaries.”

Analysts, however, say that the bulk of Hegseth’s work at ASEAN will be reassuring the bloc and its dialogue partners that the US remains committed to the region amid its months-long conflict with Iran.

The US has raised eyebrows in Asia over the past year by moving some of its military assets from South Korea and Japan to the Middle East, while Trump has also sent mixed signals on his views on Taiwan, another potential flashpoint for the region.

Trump has reportedly delayed a major arms package to Taiwan, an unofficial US ally, ahead of an upcoming meeting with Xi at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in November, before the Group of 20 (G20) Leaders’ Summit in December.

“What Hegseth says and does will be interesting,” said Ja Ian Chong, a political scientist at the National University of Singapore, because of recent comments by US defence official Elbridge Colby suggesting that Washington would focus less on empty gestures and more on substance in the Asia-Pacific region.

“How Hegseth keeps to these lines while trying to keep a US advantage will be interesting, since these are not easy calibrations to make,” Chong said.
news.content: جنگ ایران و انتقادهای دونالد ترامپ از متحدان، کشورهای منطقه آسیا و اقیانوسیه را وادار کرده است که محاسبات خود را مجدداً تنظیم کنند. پیت هگزت، وزیر دفاع ایالات متحده، این هفته در نشست دفاعی جنوب شرق آسیا در کنار همتایان خود از هند، کره جنوبی و ژاپن شرکت خواهد کرد، زیرا واشنگتن به دنبال تحکیم روابط با منطقه پس از یک سال تحت الشعاع جنگ تحت الشعاع ایران است. در این نشست مقامات دفاعی از 11 عضو انجمن کشورهای جنوب شرقی آسیا (ASEAN) و هشت شریک گفتگوی بلوک گرد هم می آیند. انتظار می رود استرالیا، نیوزیلند، روسیه و چین نیز نمایندگانی را به این مذاکرات بفرستند که از چهارشنبه تا پنجشنبه در فیلیپین برگزار می شود. این نشست که به عنوان نشست وزرای دفاع ASEAN (ADMM-Plus) شناخته می شود، در کنار یک رویداد موازی مختص اعضای آسه آن برای برونئی، کامبوج، اندونزی، لائوس، مالزی، میانمار، فیلیپین، سنگاپور، تایلند، تیمور شرقی و ویتنام برگزار می شود. به گفته رسانه های دولتی هند یکی از شرکای گفتگو است که میزبان نشست های دوجانبه در حاشیه ADMM-Plus برای "بررسی روابط دفاعی جاری و کشف راه هایی برای تقویت بیشتر مشارکت های استراتژیک" خواهد بود. ویلیام یانگ، تحلیلگر ارشد شمال شرق آسیا در گروه بین المللی بحران، به الجزیره گفت که تمرکز بر نگرانی های امنیتی منطقه ای مانند جنگ داخلی جاری میانمار و اختلافات دریایی بین کشورهای آسه آن و چین همسایه خواهد بود.

news.originalContent:
Carrick will be in charge of football’s Man United when they visit Chelsea on October 31, reports in British media say.

Michael Carrick remains in charge of Manchester United and has led the football team’s training at their Carrington training ground, giving the under-pressure manager and his players another opportunity to revive a season that has ⁠drifted alarmingly off course.

Carrick’s future had appeared in serious doubt after Sunday’s 3-0 home defeat by Bournemouth extended United’s winless run to eight matches in all competitions and left them hovering one point above the Premier League relegation ⁠zone in 16th place.

Senior club officials held talks on Monday amid mounting speculation over Carrick’s position, with potential replacements already being linked to the job by British media reports.

However, no decision was announced, and the former United midfielder reported for work as normal, overseeing preparations for Saturday’s league trip to Chelsea.

Reports in British media said Carrick and his players will have the ‌opportunity to turn the situation around, with the club focused on preparing for Saturday and showing a response on the pitch.

Amid Sunday’s frustration at Old Trafford, supporters levelled their anger at the players rather than the manager.

As Carrick made his way towards the tunnel after the final whistle, thousands of fans sang his name and applauded him. The mood shifted seconds later when cheers turned to angry boos as the players made their way off the pitch.

The scene was a reflection of the goodwill the 45-year-old Carrick still enjoys among a fanbase ⁠that remembers both his decorated 12-year playing career at United and the measured manner in ⁠which he has carried himself.

He has repeatedly accepted responsibility for the team’s struggles while shielding his players from scrutiny.

“I totally understand the situation,” he said after Sunday’s loss. “I’m not expecting anything in particular, to be honest. I’m carrying on as normal, and I love this place.

“I always ⁠do what I feel is going to be the best for the football club, whatever decision is made on anything, really.”
news.content: گزارش‌ها در رسانه‌های بریتانیایی می‌گویند که کریک در 31 اکتبر هدایت منچستر یونایتد را برعهده خواهد داشت. مایکل کریک همچنان هدایت منچستریونایتد را برعهده دارد و تمرینات تیم فوتبال را در زمین تمرینی کارینگتون رهبری کرده است و به سرمربی تحت فشار و بازیکنانش فرصتی دیگر برای احیای فصلی می‌دهد که به طرز نگران‌کننده‌ای از مسیر خارج شده است. آینده کریک پس از شکست خانگی 3-0 یکشنبه مقابل بورنموث، روند بدون برد یونایتد را به 8 بازی در تمامی رقابت‌ها افزایش داد و آنها را یک امتیاز بالاتر از منطقه سقوط لیگ برتر در رده شانزدهم قرار داد. مقامات ارشد باشگاه روز دوشنبه در میان افزایش گمانه‌زنی‌ها در مورد جانشینی کریک در انگلیس، مذاکراتی را انجام دادند. با این حال، هیچ تصمیمی اعلام نشد و هافبک سابق یونایتد به طور عادی برای کار خود گزارش داد و بر آماده سازی برای سفر شنبه لیگ به چلسی نظارت کرد. گزارش ها در رسانه های بریتانیایی حاکی از آن است که کریک و بازیکنانش این فرصت را خواهند داشت که شرایط را تغییر دهند، با تمرکز باشگاه بر آماده شدن برای شنبه و نشان دادن واکنش در زمین. در میان ناامیدی روز یکشنبه در اولدترافورد، هواداران خشم خود را به جای سرمربی، متوجه بازیکنان کردند. در حالی که کریک پس از سوت پایان به سمت تونل می رفت، هزاران هوادار نام او را خواندند و تشویقش کردند. چند ثانیه بعد وقتی بازیکنان به تشویق های خشمگین تبدیل شدند، حال و هوا عوض شد

news.originalContent:
The conflict in Sudan has left millions of children without education, as they work to help their families.

Nine-year-old Abkar Mohammed works cleaning and polishing shoes on the streets of Port Sudan every day. He arrived in the eastern Sudanese city with his mother and three siblings from Khartoum days after the country’s armed conflict erupted on April 15, 2023.

Abkar lost his father before the war began and the family live in a rented a home in al-Kasara, a low-income neighbourhood in Port Sudan.

Due to the family’s financial situation, he doesn’t go to school but does attend classes at a traditional “khalwa” where he learns the Quran.

“When my lesson finishes, I pick up my shoe-cleaning equipment and head to busy areas to work,” he told Al Jazeera. “In the evening, I take public transport home, making sure I get back before sunset.”

He gets around 1,000 Sudanese pounds ($0.11) to clean or stitch a pair of shoes, and by the end of the day, he earns around 10,000 pounds ($1.08). He gives the money to his mother to cover the family’s daily needs.

“My 23-year-old brother works on casual jobs in the markets to cover most of the household expenses,” he said.

Abkar’s story echoes the lives of eight million of the country’s 17 million school-age children who are out of school, according to UNICEF.

In Darfur, one of the areas of Sudan hardest hit by the war, about 80 percent of schools remained closed with 70 percent of children in the area not attending classes.

Save the Children estimates that children in Sudan have missed on average about 484 days of classroom learning since the war began in April 2023, due to prolonged school closures, fighting, displacement and damage to education facilities.

The Rapid Support Forces (RSF), which has been in conflict with the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) since 2023, has been accused of targeting schools and universities in drone strikes, along with other civilian infrastructure.

In September 2026, a drone attack on two warehouses in North Kordofan destroyed more than 330,000 school textbooks and other learning materials.

Sulaima Ishag, head of the Government Advisory Council for Women and Children, told Al Jazeera that children who live in conflict zones, such as Darfur and parts of Kordofan, are at greatest risk of permanently losing access to education. This can have a dire impact on their future, particularly for girls.

“[There are] cases of school dropouts and child marriage reported, alongside sexual violence. [Girls] face additional risks, including adolescent pregnancy and increased domestic responsibilities, which can further limit their chances of returning to education,” Sulaima told Al Jazeera.

“The absence of schools as safe and protective environments leaves children increasingly vulnerable to a range of threats, including child labour, early marriage, recruitment and use by armed groups, exploitation, sexual violence, trafficking and family separation. It also takes a significant psychological and social toll on children … [particularly those] from the poorest families … even in areas considered relatively safe.”

Eva Hinds, UNICEF’s head of advocacy and communication in Sudan, said that nearly half of all school buildings in the country no longer function as classrooms, due to war damage.

“Displaced children, many of whom have been forced to flee several times, face additional barriers, as repeated displacement disrupts their learning and separates them from teachers and classmates, often leaving them without learning materials or a safe place to study,” Hinds told Al Jazeera.

Children who no longer attend school lose access to a safe space and are exposed to the risks associated with child labour, recruitment by armed groups, and other abuses.

Hinds warned that the longer children remain out of school, the harder it will become for them to make up for lost learning. This disruption can deepen existing inequalities and mean that a generation of Sudanese children and young people will be unable to contribute to the country’s future peace, recovery and development.

“The conflict in Sudan continues to have a devastating impact on children’s education. The consequences extend far beyond the classroom,” said Hinds.

Psychologist Hanaa Mohamed told Al Jazeera that prolonged displacement and interruptions to schooling have taken a significant psychological toll on children. Many are in a constant state of fear, experience sleep disturbances and have difficulty focusing.

“These pressures have also led to changes in behaviour, including increased aggression or social withdrawal,” she told Al Jazeera. “Being out of school deprives children of an important protective environment. The absence of that protection has also helped bring cases of violence and sexual exploitation against children to light.”

Sudan’s economy has been set back 30 years by the war, with 60 percent of Sudanese now living in poverty.

Families fleeing the conflict often enter new towns or camps where they have few social connections and sometimes are just carrying the clothes on their backs. Sudan’s dire financial situation means that there are few jobs available for adults, forcing parents to turn to their children for essential income.

Saliha Omer, who sells tea on a street in Port Sudan, said her meagre finances prevented her from enrolling her 11-year-old son in school.

He currently works at a grocery shop in Port Sudan, but Saliha plans to return to Khartoum in the coming days so he can attend school.

“I couldn’t enrol him because of our financial circumstances after we were displaced,” Saliha told Al Jazeera.

Mahmoud al-Ghali, 16, has not been to school since the war broke out when he was aged 13, and has been displaced several times during the war.

For the past three years he has sold sweets and crisps on the streets of Port Sudan to provide his family with extra income.

Mahmoud remembers his final days at school, when he and his classmates sat their end-of-year exams. They were preparing for intermediate school and a new chapter in their lives, but the war changed their plans.

“After reaching Al-Fao in December 2023, I worked as a street vendor until I managed to save some money. Then I came to Port Sudan with my uncle in July 2025, hoping to earn more so I could help my family with household expenses,” he told Al Jazeera.

Mahmoud buys packets of crisps or sweets from local shopkeepers and sells them on the streets. At the end of the day, he pays the trader back for the goods he bought and keeps the small profit of around 20,000 Sudanese pounds, less than $3 a day.

This hand-to-mouth existence and the constant financial pressure on his family, worsened by rising cost of living, means he also has little hope of returning to school.

But his two younger brothers have now returned to classes in their village in Gaziera State after the SAF regained control of the area. Mahmoud hopes to save enough money to expand his small trading business.

“I’ve got used to working because circumstances have left me with little choice,” he said. “I no longer feel as strongly about going back to school as I once did, but I’ll keep trying so my younger brothers can finish their education.”
news.content:
درگیری در سودان میلیون‌ها کودک را بدون تحصیل رها کرده است، زیرا آنها برای کمک به خانواده‌های خود کار می‌کنند. ابکار محمد 9 ساله هر روز در خیابان‌های بندر سودان مشغول تمیز کردن و جلا دادن کفش‌ها است. او چند روز پس از شروع درگیری مسلحانه در 15 آوریل 2023 به همراه مادر و سه خواهر و برادرش از خارطوم وارد شهر شرقی سودان شد. آبکار قبل از شروع جنگ پدرش را از دست داد و خانواده در یک خانه اجاره‌ای در الکساره، محله کم درآمد پورت سودان زندگی می‌کنند. به دلیل وضعیت مالی خانواده، او به مدرسه نمی‌رود اما در کلاس‌های یک «خلوا» سنتی شرکت می‌کند که در آنجا قرآن را یاد می‌گیرد. "عصر، با وسایل نقلیه عمومی به خانه می روم و مطمئن می شوم که قبل از غروب آفتاب برمی گردم."
او برای تمیز کردن یا دوختن یک جفت کفش حدود 1000 پوند سودانی (0.11 دلار) دریافت می کند و در پایان روز حدود 10000 پوند (1.08 دلار) به دست می آورد. او این پول را به مادرش می دهد تا مایحتاج روزانه خانواده را تامین کند. او می گوید: «برادر 23 ساله ام برای تامین بیشتر مخارج خانه در بازارها در مشاغل معمولی کار می کند. به گفته یونیسف، داستان آبکار بازتاب زندگی هشت میلیون نفر از 17 میلیون کودک در سن مدرسه کشور است که از مدرسه بازمانده‌اند. در دارفور، یکی از مناطق سودان که بیشترین آسیب را از جنگ وارد کرده است، حدود 80 درصد مدارس بسته مانده و 70 درصد از کودکان در این منطقه به کلاس‌های درس نمی‌روند.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Michael Gonzalez/Getty Images)

House Speaker Mike Johnson released a long list of endorsements supporting his bid to remain House Republicans’ leader Monday two weeks before the leadership elections.

House Republicans will choose their leaders for the upcoming Congress on Nov. 10 and elect a speaker if they hold onto their narrow majority. Johnson released dozens of statements on X from several former congressional members and conservative leaders who praised his leadership over the past three years.

“Mike Johnson inherited a House GOP conference that had destroyed a Speaker and found itself so bitterly divided it could not agree on anything,” former House Speaker Newt Gingrich said. “With extraordinary patience, astonishing discipline, a refusal to get mad at people and a daily working partnership with President Trump that won again and again when defeat seemed certain, Mike created a record for legislative effectiveness that is historic.”

Johnson also quoted Heritage Foundation President Kevin Roberts, who said that Johnson had “delivered consequential conservative policy victories.” He added quotes from America First Policy Institute interim president and CEO Greg Sindelar, Americans for Tax Reform President Grover Norquist, CatholicVote CEO Kelsey Reinhardt, Election Integrity Network founder and chairman Cleta Mitchell and America First Works president Ashley Hayek. (RELATED: Mike Johnson Doubles Down On ‘Extraordinary Record’ As Affordability Crisis Threatens GOP’s House Majority)

Johnson expressed hope that House Republicans will keep the majority after Nov. 3 and that he would remain speaker.

“I don’t know what’s going to happen Nov. 4. … If I were a betting man, and I’m not, I would put all the chips on me being speaker of the House in a Republican majority,” Johnson told Punchbowl News. “I don’t think it’s going to be a red wave election. I don’t think we’re going to have a 20-seat majority, but I believe it’s going to be the majority. … I think they would expect me to continue to keep this thing going.”

Democrats need to win at least four seats to win the majority. Cook Political Report shifted 19 House races toward Democrats Friday, including a handful of Republican-held seats. The elections forecaster shifted the races in Arizona’s sixth district, Colorado’s eighth district, Virginia’s second district and Wisconsin’s third district into the “Lean Democratic” column less than two weeks before Election Day.

The race to oust Democratic Texas Rep. Henry Cuellar in Texas’ 28th district shifted to “Likely Democratic.” The Congressional Leadership Fund, the top House super PAC, canceled approximately $3 million in planned advertisement spending against Cuellar while the incumbent congressman held a 20-point lead in the polls.

The Congressional Leadership Fund slashed $6 million in planned advertising Wednesday in Florida’s 25th district, where Republicans hoped to oust Democratic Florida Rep. Jared Moskowitz. The No Going Back PAC, a super PAC backed by MAGA Inc., planned to spend $6.3 million in the district.

Two other races in Texas’ 34th district and North Carolina’s eleventh district shifted from toss ups to leaning Democratic. Texas’ 34th district is held by Democratic Texas Rep. Vicente Gonzalez, who is seeking reelection. North Carolina’s district is held by Republican North Carolina Rep. Chuck Edwards, who announced he would not seek reelection after investigators concluded he engaged in inappropriate conduct.

(عکس از مایکل گونزالس/گتی ایماژ)
مایک جانسون، رئیس مجلس نمایندگان، روز دوشنبه دو هفته قبل از انتخابات رهبری، فهرست بلندبالایی از تاییدیه‌های حمایت از تلاش او برای ماندن در رهبری جمهوری‌خواهان مجلس را منتشر کرد. جمهوری‌خواهان مجلس نمایندگان رهبران خود را برای کنگره آتی در 10 نوامبر انتخاب خواهند کرد و در صورت حفظ اکثریت محدود، رئیس مجلس نمایندگان را انتخاب خواهند کرد. جانسون ده‌ها بیانیه در مورد X از چندین عضو سابق کنگره و رهبران محافظه‌کار منتشر کرد که رهبری او را در سه سال گذشته ستایش کردند. نیوت گینگریچ، رئیس سابق مجلس نمایندگان گفت: «مایک جانسون وارث کنفرانس جمهوری‌خواهان مجلس نمایندگان شد که یک رئیس مجلس را نابود کرده بود و خود را آن‌قدر تلخ دید که نتوانست در مورد چیزی به توافق برسد. مایک با صبر فوق‌العاده، نظم و انضباط شگفت‌انگیز، امتناع از عصبانی شدن با مردم و مشارکت کاری روزانه با پرزیدنت ترامپ که زمانی که شکست قطعی به نظر می‌رسید، پیروز شد، رکوردی برای اثربخشی قانون‌گذاری ایجاد کرد که تاریخی است.»
جانسون همچنین به نقل از کوین رابرتز، رئیس بنیاد هریتیج، گفت که جانسون «پیروزی‌های مهمی را در سیاست محافظه‌کاران به ارمغان آورده است. او نقل قول هایی از گرگ سیندلار، رئیس و مدیر عامل مؤسسه سیاست اول آمریکا، گروور نورکویست، رئیس آمریکایی ها برای اصلاحات مالیاتی، کلسی راینهارت، مدیر اجرایی CatholicVote، کلتا میچل، بنیانگذار و رئیس شبکه یکپارچگی انتخابات، و اشلی هایک، رئیس America First Works، اضافه کرد. تهدید
